in_marathi.name: Dhaval
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mountain of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhaval हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dhaval is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Dhau’, meaning mountain. It is a name that signifies the divine presence of the Almighty and is often used to describe someone who is strong and steadfast, like a mountain.

vedic_reference.note: Dhaval is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'धवल्' (dhaval), which means 'dhupaprad' or 'one who provides fragrance'. In Hindu mythology, Dhaval is the name of a sage who was blessed with the power to dispel darkness and bring light. He is also mentioned in the Rigveda as one of the seven sons of Sage Angiras.
